notes: Swept v0.109.0..v0.110.0 on branch docs/sweep-v0.110.0, based on origin/main at the v0.110.0 tag (0465122f7f). Most large in-release programs had already shipped their own docs (reboot deferral in patch-management.mdx, device-set billing across contracts/invoices/quotes/devices, AI graduation + impact, QuickBooks push/pull-back narrative), so this sweep closed the gaps around them. Biggest gap by far was features/portal.mdx, which predated #4562 entirely — added Dashboard, Devices, Security, Backups, Reports sections, the five visibility toggles, the Settings path to change them, fail-closed behaviour, and the new portal API rows. Also: unrated-patch handling (patch-management + update-rings, including the previously undocumented autoApproveUnrated ring toggle), scripts Run again / Duplicate / Target session, AI credit balance tile, audit-retention default-policy trigger for new orgs + AUDIT_MANAGE permission row, ticketing requester-contact model, deploy/tls internal-CA option, and ~20 new optional env vars in deploy/environment.mdx. Corrected four factually-wrong claims: deploy/upgrades.mdx v0.110.0 said 'no new environment variables' (there are ~20 optional ones); scripts.mdx claimed the cancel route kills the process group on the device (it does not — it only flips DB state and cancels undelivered commands); enrollment-keys.mdx and environment.mdx still said the default key TTL is 60 minutes and that the partner-API/installer paths diverge (all three paths are 30 days since #4506). Verified against source, not the release notes: BREEZE_AUTHENTICATOR_ATTESTATION_ENFORCED defaults ON, not off, and QuickBooks pull_payments defaults true — both documented as verified. Deliberately NOT documented: script cancellation as a user-facing feature (only #3525 W01/W02 backend scaffolding shipped — no UI, no dispatch path), the platform-admin AI kill switch (operator-only, already covered by docs/deploy/ai-kill-switch.md), and partner trust probation as a feature doc (hosted-only and inert on self-hosted; its env vars are documented in deploy/environment.mdx instead).
